docs.summary: A registered navmesh inside a [`NavMeshWorld`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshWorld): the instantiated Detour navmesh, its query pool, and the lock that lets queries run from any thread while tile mutations (rebakes, partial rebuilds) exclude them. Obtained from [`AddNavMeshData`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshWorld~AddNavMeshData); advanced users can reach the raw Detour objects through [`NativeNavMesh`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshInstance~NativeNavMesh).
How many obstacles this navmesh may carve at once.

The underlying Detour navmesh, owned by the tile cache. Advanced use; mutating it directly bypasses the query locking and desyncs it from the cache that built it. Prefer [`MutateTileCache`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshWorld~MutateTileCache) for tile changes.
Whether the mesh holds a traversable connection stamped with the given link id (see [`LinkId`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshLink~LinkId)). Main thread.
